verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence of background automation is a developer-site use case: when a PDF lands in an inbox folder, Box AI Extract automatically pulls fields into metadata (box-docs-12). It is unclear whether this is a configurable product feature or an example assembled from webhooks/events, which are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented user-configurable automation/workflow builder, trigger-action rules running autonomously, scheduling, details on how such automations are set up and managed, independent or hands-on corroboration.
